verdict.rationale: AMD clearly exposes the NPU to developers through a shipping, versioned SDK (Ryzen AI Software 1.8.0). It offers an ONNX Runtime Vitis AI Execution Provider, NPU-only and hybrid NPU+iGPU LLM execution via OGA and Lemonade, the Quark quantizer, the xrt-smi NPU management tool, and BF16 auto-conversion. However, nothing in the pack states a TOPS figure, or the precision it is measured at, for this chip. Missing for 10: a published NPU TOPS figure with stated precision, and independent or hands-on corroboration of NPU (not GPU/llama.cpp) use on the 395.
